subject: Nexus Pod — canopy height variance, pod orientation, and collateral kitting
messages:
From: Elena Rivera <elena@eventworks.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nexus Pod position options + canopy variance info

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for choosing the Nexus Pod spot in the Partnership Pavilion. Attached is pavilion-floorplan-v3.pdf with three proposed orientations for your pod (A/B/C). Notes:

- Option A is closest to the main demo corridor (best sightlines).
- Option B gives a wider demo queue area but sits nearer the east egress (requires a 6 ft clear path).
- Option C is tucked behind the lounge — lower foot traffic but quieter demos.

Couple things you should know up front:
1) Any canopy or overhead hanging over 8 ft will need a variance and sign-off from the venue fire marshal. We can start the permit request but will need final canopy dimensions, hanging weight, and manufacturing spec sheet.
2) If you plan to hang printed signage from the truss, supply us the weight-per-point and anchor locations.
3) Crate/staging window: load-in is Fri 04/15 07:00-10:00am for sponsor builds; we can hold crates in the crossdock if you ship with our manifest template.

Attached: pavilion-floorplan-v3.pdf (high-res), manifest template available on request.

Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to walk the options.

Best,
Elena Rivera
Senior Events Producer, EventWorks
elena@eventworks.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: pavilion-floorplan-v3.pdf (plan, 2.9MB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@eventworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nexus Pod position options + canopy variance info

Elena —

Appreciate the options and the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from our side:

- We prefer Option A for visibility but are concerned about the egress proximity noted for Option B. Can you confirm the measured clearance from the A plan to the nearest emergency lane? We need to ensure compliance; if A brushes an egress by less than 10 inches we're going to have to shift.
- We do intend to suspend a lightweight fabric canopy (aluminum frame + fabric skin). Can you confirm the max allowable hanging weight per anchor and whether the ceiling grid points are rated for point loads?
- Power: we need two isolated 20A drops (one for demo rig, one for AV). Please confirm the drop locations in the A orientation.
- Crate manifest: please send the manifest template and crate tag format. We'll prep goods to arrive on 04/14 (preferred) for crossdock staging.

Attaching a quick sketch (nexus-pod-sketch.png) with our proposed canopy footprint and an approximate hanging point. Marissa, Monica — can you confirm whether we have any large banner panels that also need to hang from the canopy? Aditya — FYI on the shipping window.

If you can route the canopy variance checklist and the permit form, we'll get measurements and spec sheets over by EOD Monday. If helpful, I'm available for a 30-minute call Monday 9–10am PT.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments: nexus-pod-sketch.png

From: Elena Rivera <elena@eventworks.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <m.chen@eventworks.com>, Fire Marshal <firemarshal@conventioncenter.org>
Date: Sun, 12 Feb 2028 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nexus Pod position options + canopy variance info

Sean —

Thanks — got the sketch and that helps. Quick answers inline: 

- Option A clearance to egress: 12 ft clear lane shown on the plan; A meets the standing fire code for the venue so you should be fine. I'll attach a markup showing the exact measurement.
- Hanging weight: ceiling grid anchor points are rated to 100 lbs per point but any concentrated load > 50 lbs requires structural review and permit submission. For fabric canopy + two printed panels you're likely under 50 lbs total, but please provide the spec sheet.
- Power drops: I confirmed with our lead electrician — two isolated 20A drops can be delivered as noted on the A plan; drop locations are flagged on the attached markup.
- Permit: canopy variance requires our internal permit request plus sign-off from the venue fire marshal. Start by filling permit-guidelines.pdf and our online request form (link below).

I've looped in Michael Chen (logistics) — Michael, can you share the crossdock manifest template and crate tag spec? Sean, once you confirm crate weights and pallets we'll create the crossdock booking.

Link to permit request: https://eventworks.example.com/permit-request/4782

Regards,
Elena Rivera
Senior Events Producer, EventWorks

Attachments: permit-guidelines.pdf, pavilion-floorplan-v3-markup.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rivera <elena@eventworks.com>, Michael Chen <m.chen@eventworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nexus Pod position options + canopy variance info

Hi Elena / Michael —

Thanks for confirming details and for the permit link. We're green to proceed with Option A and will start the permit submission. Below are the canopy specs and our crate manifest draft. Please confirm any fields missing for the crossdock booking.

Canopy specs (for permit):
- Frame: aluminum truss (2" x 2"), vendor: SkyFrame Inc., model SF-ALU-3
- Fabric skin: 11 oz blockout, 14 ft x 10 ft footprint, peak height 9.0 ft above finished floor, nominal hanging weight 36 lbs (evenly distributed)
- Hanging points: 4 corners, estimated 9 lbs per anchor

Crate manifest (draft):
1) CRATE A — Demo rig + monitor stand — 1 crate — 520 lbs — 48x40x40 in — palletized
2) CRATE B — Swag + printed collateral — 2 crates — 310 lbs total — 36x24x30 in
3) CRATE C — Canopy frame (disassembled) — 1 crate — 220 lbs — 60x30x18 in
4) CRATE D — Tools + spare signage — 1 crate — 85 lbs — 24x18x18 in

Planned ship date: 2028-04-12 (arrive crossdock 04/14)
On-site crew: 3 pax (Sean, Marissa, field tech)

Attachments: crate-manifest-REDFINX-02-14.csv (manifest CSV), canopy-spec-sheet.pdf (will follow in separate mail)

Ask: Michael — can you confirm the crossdock cut-off time and whether you require inbound ASN / Pro number on the BOL? Also confirm crate tag format (we typically use: REDW-YYMMDD-CRATE-#).

If everything looks good I'll submit the permit tonight and book the crossdock once I have the manifest template from you.

Thanks,
Sean
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
